title: Stop Uploading PDFs to Claude
description:
Reduce Claude tokens by up to 90% — free tool from Microsoft converts your files to markdown before upload.
I tested it myself: same document, 9,275 tokens as a PDF, 985 tokens as markdown. Setup takes 5 minutes.

Free setup guide — convert your files to markdown before uploading to Claude and cut token usage by up to 90%.

What's covered:
- One-time Python + MarkItDown setup
- The convert script + batch file
- Works on PDFs, Word docs, PowerPoints, spreadsheets, and YouTube videos

👉 https://chadesheppard.com/markitdown
